Acme Weather API

The Acme Weather API returns current conditions and forecasts for any location worldwide.

Base URL

All requests are made to https://api.acmeweather.example/v2.

Authentication

Authenticate every request by sending your API key in the X-Api-Key header. Keys are created in the dashboard.

curl https://api.acmeweather.example/v2/forecast?city=Sofia \
  -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_KEY"

Clients that cannot set headers may pass the key as the api_key query parameter instead.

Server-to-server integrations can also use HTTP Basic authentication, with the API key as the username and an empty password.

Versioning

The major version is part of the URL path (/v2).

Errors

Errors use standard HTTP status codes and a JSON body:

{ "error": { "code": "invalid_city", "message": "City not found" } }
